syncCommitReason: Actual parent HEAD is unborn. Reviewed source SHA-256 values are the synchronization record.

actionCoverage.BeginStart: Canonical-root start enters claimProjectService. Only premature-snapshot scratch mutation loads openWorkspace here.
actionCoverage.ReadDiscovery: discover reads connection snapshot and identity without writable workspace. Recheck is a separate discover after awaited exclusive bind.
actionCoverage.AcquireReservation: Await net.Server.listen on deterministic root-derived loopback address with exclusive true. Reservation lasts until drained owner release.
actionCoverage.ReservationBusy: EADDRINUSE waits 25ms and repeats discovery. No reservation stealing or new writable snapshot.
actionCoverage.ReservationTimeout: Bounded claim deadline rejects. Model abstracts elapsed time nondeterministically; no fairness or eventual attachment claim.
actionCoverage.AttachToOwner: Healthy authenticated same-root fetch plus unchanged reread returns attached. Under-reservation attachment separately releases the unused reservation.
actionCoverage.ProbeRecordChanged: After a pending fetch, discover compares text and inode/time identity. Removed or changed record repeats discovery before PID liveness interpretation.
actionCoverage.ProbeFailedLivePid: Failed unchanged-record probe with still-live or unknown PID rejects. All modeled participant PIDs remain alive even after service close.
actionCoverage.ReleaseNonOwner: Release reservation after recheck attachment or failed recheck; no writable workspace is returned.
actionCoverage.LoadWorkspace: Owner branch opens current disk snapshot only after awaited claim, then applies pending maintenance. Mutant moves this exact load before claim.
actionCoverage.ListenerReady: Actual HTTP listen callback resolves readiness promise. Publication is a subsequent continuation.
actionCoverage.CheckPublication: publish compares expected record twice around exclusive temporary-file write. Final comparison precedes atomic rename. Different OS processes can interleave between comparison and rename without reservation.
actionCoverage.PublicationRejected: Unexpected record replacement before final publication comparison rejects and enters the same stop-and-drain cleanup.
actionCoverage.PublishConnection: Atomic temporary-file rename publishes token/root/port/pid and admits writes. Distinct from final comparison across OS processes.
actionCoverage.BeginSave: Authenticated HTTP handler starts awaiting request body; one pending new-path request per caller.
actionCoverage.SaveWalkthrough: Body finishes, assertWritable checks published phase immediately before synchronous workspace.invoke/save. Atomic whole-snapshot disk replacement and successful HTTP acknowledgement are abstracted as one successful-save action.
actionCoverage.RejectPending: Close phase fence or destroyed incomplete socket rejects a pending body without accepted write.
actionCoverage.CloseAdmission: claim.close synchronously switches phase to closing and caches an idempotent closing promise.
actionCoverage.StopHttp: stopAndDrain stops HTTP admission and destroys tracked sockets. Its synchronous portion follows CloseAdmission in the same process turn; splitting conservatively allows other processes to run.
actionCoverage.DrainHandlers: Await HTTP closure and all tracked handler promises. No demo children in model. No release on failed drain.
actionCoverage.RemoveConnection: After drainage compare parse(readConnection(root))?.token === token before unlink. Token identities, not PID or port, determine ownership.
actionCoverage.ReleaseReservation: Await reservation.close last; only then closed. Process death and crash recovery are not modeled.
actionCoverage.CloseAttached: Remote attached close does not stop owner or edit connection.
actionCoverage.ReplaceWithForeignRecord: One bounded environment action replaces a published active-owner record with a foreign token before close admission. This is not a protocol-respecting second writer. No hostile concurrent filesystem interference inside modeled synchronous cleanup.
actionCoverage.Done: All callers closed or blocked, with no pending body, is a legitimate terminal state with stuttering. Busy discovery cycles are waits, not liveness proofs.
actionCoverage.ProtocolOnlyView: Optional statechart-only constraint. Stop exploration after the bounded external foreign replacement; never used by the main safety check.
actionCoverage.FailedProbeFreshnessSchedule: Supplementary action-constrained check requires the first accepted path save while another caller probes that owner. Main checks remain unconstrained. A violating mutant trace must include ProbeRecordChanged.

astCorrespondence.ExclusiveReservation: Derive from actual awaited reservation.listen options and release implementation. No-op mutation changes both await and release of the unbound server.
astCorrespondence.FreshSnapshot: Derive from the actual openWorkspace declaration position and block ancestry relative to awaited claimProjectService.
astCorrespondence.RequireOwnerToken: Derive from the actual helper if condition directly guarding fs.unlinkSync(connection).
astCorrespondence.reviewedStructure: AST also checks both discovery calls, failed-probe identity reread before live-PID refusal, listen-before-publish, double publication check, close/admission/drain/unlink/release order, immediate generic mutation fence, and synchronous actual workspace save.

scope.multipleProcesses: Two same-host protocol participants; atomic individual disk writes and OS reservation exclusion assumed, not proved.
scope.network: Healthy loopback except a probed owner may close before its request completes.
excluded: reservation hash collisions and unrelated port occupancy
hostile filesystem replacement during synchronous cleanup

sourceReview.latestOwnerPolish: Copied and reread the three authorized mirrored files. The later service change waits for Go child close instead of exit/error and reports process errors. No effect on this non-demo finite model. Demo child lifecycle remains excluded.
sourceReview.workspace: Parent reviewed the combined annotation, callback-role and read-only source-usage changes from ab392f0162d3cb33767ddaa233e36fee5c96a3643f8c77a6312c4d714c5a58bf. Workspace loading and the synchronous save/write fence remain unchanged. New annotation operations synchronously clone/replace one current path and preserve other paths, with local rollback. Source usage is read-only. These content/update semantics remain outside the finite new-path model and have separate runtime tests. The maintained decision boundary is recorded in actionCoverage, astCorrespondence and scope; temporary working reports have been removed.
sourceReview.history: Only the private baseline commit and working source diff are available. No actual parent application commit exists.
sourceReview.notePresentation: Reviewed optional variableName/archived metadata and shared NoteRevision snapshots. The exact workspace diff and ownership AST correspondence were reviewed; retained source fingerprints and action mappings record the synchronization boundary, while temporary reports are disposable. No ownership, synchronous save or deferred-write change; content/presentation semantics remain excluded from the finite model.
